Source: Sherdog Fight Finder, https://www.sherdog.com/
Source operator identified by its terms: Evolve Media Holdings, LLC.
Terms reviewed: 2026-10-08; see LICENSE.txt.

crossorg_bouts.parquet contains structured bout records extracted from Sherdog
event cards and fighter career pages. It combines the six-promotion event crawl
with whole-career records, preferring event-card rows when the sources overlap.
The loaders are loaders/sherdog_org_loader.py, build_sherdog_majors.py and
build_sherdog_careers.py. It contains factual fields and source identifiers,
not complete HTML pages, photographs or articles.

The event_href, fighter_a_href and fighter_b_href columns retain source paths;
prefix them with https://www.sherdog.com. Some career rows use an ID-based
placeholder fighter path; the numeric fighter ID is the provenance identifier.
The source column distinguishes event cards from fighter pages.

The repository records whole-career completion on 2026-09-08 in
build_sherdog_careers.py and docs/DECISIONS.md. This is a processing milestone,
not a retrieval timestamp. The Parquet does not retain per-page retrieval dates.

Attribution does not establish permission to redistribute the extracted
compilation. No such licence or permission record was identified; see LICENSE.txt.
